data.narrative:
Kela is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $100M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms, including four same-stage private comparables—Stark Defence ($4.0B), Castelion ($1.0B), Singularity ($400M), and NODA AI ($125M).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using total raised as a proxy for current valuation, applies a standard 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, yielding $200M. The peer-median method across four Defense & Security Series A companies produces a median valuation of $700M, with a range of $125M to $4.0B reflecting material dispersion in the cohort. The peer set spans established defense platforms and emerging security AI vendors.

The two methods triangulate to a range of $170M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $450M. This wide spread reflects genuine heterogeneity in the peer group: comparable companies span nearly a 32x valuation range. Key uncertainties include revenue and growth profile relative to peers, customer concentration and contract visibility, and the applicable multiple given Kela's specific technology and market position within Defense & Security. Narrowing the range would require additional revenue and profitability data.
